items.why: Chip stocks are tumbling today, with the S&P 500 and Nasdaq falling as investors test the Nvidia-fueled rally.
Nvidia is sliding and giving back part of Monday's rally, with the Nasdaq declining as AI stocks erase some of the gain.
No single headline; moving with the broader tape.
The Nasdaq is falling as chip stocks tumble and Nvidia euphoria wears off, dragging the index lower.

summary: Stocks are lower at midday as chip stocks tumble and investors test the Nvidia-fueled rally from Monday. The Nasdaq is leading the slide while the Dow holds up.
